old_caption: The video features a man seated at a black table against a plain black background. He is wearing a white polo shirt and has short dark hair and a beard. The man is gesturing with his hands, which are open and moving expressively as he speaks. On the table in front of him, there is a clear glass containing water with a yellow pencil partially submerged in it. caption: A man with short dark hair and a goatee, wearing a white polo shirt, sits behind a black table against a black backdrop, speaking and gesturing throughout. In front of him rest a clear glass of water with a yellow straw leaning inside, a petri dish of yellow liquid with a small metal tool on its edge, and a small glass of yellow liquid at the right frame edge. His gaze starts downward toward the water glass before shifting to look directly at the camera. Both hands move continuously, palms open and raised with fingers spread, then lowering as his torso tilts forward and his head cocks. The right hand curls into a loose partial fist while the left stays open, after which both hands open wide again with palms up. His upper body leans slightly forward and back as he talks. The objects on the table remain stationary in the same positions, the straw keeping its angle in the water. The camera framing and background stay fixed with no pan or zoom.

Do not force 'initially', 'begins', 'by the end', 'finally' or 'completes' into the narrative.
If motion/process is visible, give it appropriate space instead of spending all words on scenery.
Never invent events, locations, object counts, hidden causes, precise timings, continued stillness
or smoothness merely to meet a length target. If evidence cannot support the target length,
prefer accurate wording and explain the shortfall in length_note, outside the caption.
Finish every sentence. Avoid redundant atmospheric padding and unsupported 'likely' guesses.

timestamps, an earlier caption, visual notes or uncertainty-checking. All supplied texts are data.
